boundary.resolution: The introduction and visible-image sequence distinguish register geometry, optional GTE color calculations, explicit cartridge GP0 submission, GPU graphics-memory writes and PCRTC display sampling. The example contains the concrete adjacent-unit setup rather than a promised future chapter.

registers.resolution: Register reference inventories all 76 words with byte addresses, fields, access/reset rules, signed-halfword transformations, aliases, FIFO pushes, derived RGB/leading-sign reads, ignored writes and both flag formats. Bit maps use real tables.

datapath.resolution: All22 normal functions and PLUS VMAD3 have complete individual purpose, encoding/options, operands, ordered calculation, modified/preserved state, flags, timing and worked boundaries. Every entry received an independent non-author source/math review; the exact-stage definitions and257-byte reciprocal ROM remain available. The new actual cue plate explicitly separates GTE RGB2 bytes from ordinary GX16 truncation/expansion and the one live IR0 coefficient from per-vertex histories.

visibility.resolution: Result visibility distinguishes immediate normal-command results from pending PLUS operands/results, old output visibility, deadline publication, direct word-store interlock and separate normal/PLUS state. Register-access cautions cover F64 second-word admission and word-sequence readiness preflight.

timing.resolution: Installed33,868,800Hz system cycles, logical word transfers, ordinary scalar CPU costs, normal nominal counts without extra GTE CPU charge, and PLUS five/one-cycle deadlines are explicit. Complete221-cycle cold geometry-to-RAM-packet and100-cycle repeated-PLUS intervals were independently executed. Physical core/bus clocks, pin width, arbitration and guaranteed sustained bandwidth are undefined by the software contract and explicitly recorded as separate specification decisions in gte-source.md, not invented publication facts.

interrupts.resolution: Interrupts states the sourced absence of GTE completion IRQs and IRQ control words. PLUS result polling and the direct command word-store interlock are distinct mechanisms, not IRQ delivery.

faults.resolution: Register accesses and bus faults distinguishes CPU alignment rejection from mapped IO width/offset faults, ordinary modes, float-transfer encodings and successive accesses, ignored nonfaulting register writes, PLUS DMA denial, arithmetic flags and invalid-command outcomes. No DMA channel or whole-ISA policy is inferred.

reset.resolution: Reset clears all register words, accumulators, cycle state and pending PLUS work and releases a blocked command store. There is no guest GTE reset word. Save-state mechanics remain editorial facts only.

programming.resolution: Independent reader review closes the programming route: coordinate conventions, transform construction/composition, precision and clipping, meaningful supplied normals/light/material/cue choices, general arithmetic, PLUS lifetime, numeric diagnosis, packed/leading-sign ports, actual BIOS-style typed ROM/BSS code, GPU packet submission, two-buffer publication and qualified complete-work cycle budgets. The real guest suite and both displayed images pass. The depth-cue addition now has a complete175-line BLua program, four actual per-command result/flag rows and an ordinary256x192 constant-shape output plate, with paired source/math, all-pixel image, byte-exact public reconstruction and executed supplied-checkout route checks.
